# truenas_iscsi_targetextent (Resource)

Manages an iSCSI target/extent association (LUN mapping) on TrueNAS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_iscsi_target" "vm" {
  name = "vm-storage"
  mode = "ISCSI"
  groups = [
    {
      portal     = truenas_iscsi_portal.main.id
      authmethod = "NONE"
    }
  ]
}

resource "truenas_iscsi_extent" "vm_disk" {
  name    = "vm-disk"
  type    = "DISK"
  disk    = "zvol/tank/vms/vm1"
  enabled = true
}

# Associate the extent with the target as LUN 0.
resource "truenas_iscsi_targetextent" "vm_lun0" {
  target = truenas_iscsi_target.vm.id
  extent = truenas_iscsi_extent.vm_disk.id
  lunid  = 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `extent` (Number) ID of the iSCSI extent to associate.
- `target` (Number) ID of the iSCSI target to associate.

### Optional

- `lunid` (Number) LUN ID for this association. Omit to let TrueNAS auto-assign the next available LUN ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric iSCSI target/extent association ID assigned by TrueNAS.
